verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS operations-automation platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no SDK, client library, or developer API. The only developer-adjacent item is a bare 'GitHubCode' link label, and probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
